title: placement.set_window, contract version 1
description: Sets the window in which a placement is live in one locale (PRD 5.7, 6.4): the placement, the version of it the caller read, the locale and the window; a null window hides the placement in the locale. A placement at another version is version_conflict. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Placements\Domain\Commands\SetPlacementWindow, and the generated codec SetPlacementWindowCodecV1 reads it and writes its canonical JSON: every key, sorted, no whitespace.

locale.description: The locale the window applies in.

version.description: The version of the placement the caller read.

window.description: The window the placement is live in, or null to hide it in the locale.

locale.description: A language tag of a language, an optional script and an optional region, such as da, en-GB or sr-Latn-RS; the kernel writes the language in lowercase, the script in title case and the region in uppercase.

time_window.description: When a placement is live: from live_from, inclusive, until live_until, exclusive, each RFC 3339 with an offset, stored in UTC. A null or missing live_from is since always, and a null or missing live_until for ever; live_from is before live_until.

live_from.description: When the placement goes live, RFC 3339 with an offset, or null for since always.

live_until.description: When the placement stops being live, RFC 3339 with an offset, or null for ever.

version.description: The version of an aggregate that the caller read, an integer of 1 or more; the command is version_conflict when the aggregate is at another version when it commits.
